title: K-nearest index of typicality in hidden layers (KITH): Machine metacognition for AI models
thumbnail_alt: KITH final step: training images mapped, with two new images placed and scored
summary: AI models are often as confident when they are wrong as when they are right. KITH is a general method that lets a model judge how far to trust its own answer, by checking how familiar a new case is compared with the cases it learned from. The idea borrows from how people judge their own confidence. In a skin lesion demonstration, it improved classification, especially for confident mistakes.
